definitions_en: n. the act of managing something

examples.zh: 今天沒有人能想像一個沒有電視的生活。

examples.zh: 理论上说，理论和实践没有区别。但实践上说，是有的。

examples.en: What do you base your theory on?
examples.zh: 你的理論是以什麼為基礎?

definitions_en: n. the striking of one body against another

examples.en: Afterwards, because it was sanctioned by many of the successive dynasties Buddhism became widespread and had a tremendous impact on the development of Chinese thought, culture and art.
examples.zh: 后来，因为接连的许多朝代都批准它，佛教变得更分部广的并对中国精神、文化和艺术的发展有极大的影响。

examples.zh: 这个事件极大影响了项目进度。

examples.zh: 我们的身体会对我们的感情做出反应。

examples.zh: 他沒有回答我的問題。

definitions_en: n. a message that is stated or declared; a communication (oral or written) setting forth particulars or facts etc
n. (music) the presentation of a musical theme
n. a nonverbal message
n. a document showing credits and debits
translations_zh: n. 陈述, 指令, 声明

examples.zh: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。

examples.en: I began to doubt the accuracy of his statement.
examples.zh: 我開始懷疑他陳述的準確性。

definitions_en: v. state or assert

examples.zh: 維持一個人的聲譽是很難的。

examples.zh: 彼此必須一輩子努力,才能把感情维系好。

definitions_en: n. an impetuous rush toward someone or something
n. (criminal law) a pleading describing some wrong or offense
n. the price charged for some article or service

examples.zh: 银行对风险客户收取较高的贷款利息。

examples.zh: 将费用记在我的账上。

definitions_en: a. regarded with great favor, approval, or affection especially by the general public
s. carried on by or for the people (or citizens) at large

examples.zh: 園藝在這幾年很流行。

examples.zh: 鮑勃在學校很受歡迎。

definitions_en: a. consisting of or derived from tradition
s. pertaining to time-honored orthodox doctrines

[经] 传统的, 惯例的

examples.zh: 那是一個十分傳統的儀式。

examples.zh: 谁能揭开海洋的奥秘？

n. the spatial relation between something and the course along which it points or moves

examples.zh: 你一点方向感都没有。

examples.zh: 她完全沒有方向感，很容易便會迷路。

examples.zh: 耐心有时候是最有效的武器。

examples.en: He used his umbrella as a weapon.
examples.zh: 他用他的雨傘當作武器。

examples.en: It is difficult to replace an employee that is as qualified as he is.
examples.zh: 要找人代替像他这么有资历的员工很难。

examples.zh: 一分耕耘，一分收穫。

examples.zh: 喝了幾杯酒後，這個傢伙就感覺不痛了。

examples.zh: 如果你想要這份工作的話，就一定要在明天之前申請。

examples.en: I haven't decided which job to apply for.

examples.zh: 這個議案合符我們的政策內容。

examples.zh: 我們感覺到房子搖動了一下。

examples.zh: 你的面试怎么样？

examples.zh: 能把經濟管好的政府不多。

examples.zh: 人们怎么能在飞机上睡觉？

examples.zh: 我想特别强调这一点。

examples.zh: 我要给我自己买一个新照相机，这次要数码的。

examples.zh: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。

examples.zh: 奇怪的是，誰也沒有投那候選人一票。

examples.zh: 老师应该一视同仁地对待他们的学生。

examples.zh: Ken把衬衫穿反了。

examples.zh: 會議將在東京舉行。

examples.zh: 许多国家的代表出席了会议。

examples.zh: 模为1的向量是单位向量。

examples.zh: 那时，分队办公室里电话响了。

examples.zh: 我们谈论了各种各样的话题。

examples.zh: 我至始至终都在支持你。

examples.zh: 他的行為由始至終都是對的。

examples.zh: 这份工作没什么挑战性。

translations_zh: vi. 注视, 凝视, 瞪视, 显眼
vt. 盯
n. 凝视

examples.en: It is rude to stare at strangers.
examples.zh: 盯著陌生人看是不禮貌的。

examples.en: It isn't polite to stare at people.
examples.zh: 盯著人看是不禮貌的。

definitions_en: n. the state of being certain that adverse effects will not be caused by some agent under defined conditions
n. a safe place
n. a score in American football; a player is tackled behind his own goal line
translations_zh: n. 安全, 保险, 平安, 保安设备
vt. 保护, 防护

examples.en: Safety is what matters most.
examples.zh: 最重要的是安全。

examples.en: A bus driver is responsible for the safety of the passengers.
examples.zh: 巴士司機有責任保護乘客的安全。

definitions_en: a. producing or capable of producing an intended result or having a striking effect
s. able to accomplish a purpose; functioning effectively
s. works well as a means or remedy
s. exerting force or influence
translations_zh: a. 有效的, 有力的, 实际的
n. 有生力量

examples.en: The art of modern warfare does not necessarily require soldiers to be armed to the teeth to be effective as combatants.
examples.zh: 現代戰術並無指明士兵必須全副武裝上陣才能發揮其最大的戰鬥力。

examples.en: This poison is very effective in getting rid of roaches.
examples.zh: 這毒藥用來治蟑螂很有效。

definitions_en: n. something that serves as a model or a basis for making copies
s. preceding all others in time or being as first made or performed
s. (of e.g. information) not secondhand or by way of something intermediary
a. being or productive of something fresh and unusual; or being as first made or thought of
translations_zh: a. 最初的, 原始的, 有创意的
n. 原物, 原作

examples.en: The translation is quite true to the original.
examples.zh: 翻译跟原文很贴切。

examples.en: He adhered to the original plan.
examples.zh: 他堅持原來的計畫。

definitions_en: n. a group of soldiers
n. a cavalry unit corresponding to an infantry company
n. a unit of Girl or Boy Scouts
n. an orderly crowd
translations_zh: n. 军队, 一群, 一队
vi. 群集, 结队, 成群而行

examples.en: a troop of children
They children trooped into the room

definitions_en: n. the financial gain (earned or unearned) accruing over a given period of time
translations_zh: n. 收入, 收益, 流入
[经] 收益

examples.en: Now my income is twice what it was two years ago.
examples.zh: 我現在的收入比兩年前多了一倍。

examples.en: My income is a far cry from his.
examples.zh: 我的工资比他少多了。

definitions_en: r. without deviation
r. without anyone or anything intervening
r. in a forthright manner; candidly or frankly
translations_zh: adv. 径直地, 直接地, 直率地, 正好地, 直截了当地, (非正式)立即, 马上
[计] 直接的

examples.en: I got the information from him directly.
examples.zh: 我直接從他那裡得到訊息。

examples.en: If you ask her too directly whether she has a friend, she will become suspicious and answer: "Why did you ask me that?"
examples.zh: 如果你太直接问她有没有朋友，她会怀疑且反问：“你为什么要这样问？”

definitions_en: v. give trouble or pain to
v. cause damage or affect negatively
v. hurt the feelings of
v. feel physical pain
translations_zh: n. 伤害, 创伤, 损害
v. 伤害, (使)伤心, 危害, 刺痛

examples.en: These shoes are too tight. They hurt.
examples.zh: 这些鞋子太紧了，伤脚。

examples.en: Don't cry before you're hurt.
examples.zh: 不要在你受傷之前哭。

definitions_en: n. (biology) taxonomic group whose members can interbreed
n. a specific kind of something
translations_zh: n. 种, 类, 外形
[医] 茶剂; 种

examples.en: Butterflies of this species are now extinct.
examples.zh: 這品種的蝴蝶現在已經絕種了。

examples.en: Gambling site lets users bet on which species will go extinct because of the oil spill in the Gulf of Mexico.
examples.zh: 賭博網站讓用戶投注在將滅絕的物種上，因為墨西哥灣漏油。

definitions_en: r. without delay or hesitation; with no time intervening
r. near or close by
r. bearing an immediate relation
translations_zh: adv. 直接地, 立刻, 立即

examples.en: In case anything happens, call me immediately.
examples.zh: 如果發生了甚麼事，馬上打電話給我。

examples.en: Yes, I'm coming immediately.
examples.zh: 是的，我马上来。

definitions_en: n. a pair of parallel rails providing a runway for wheels
n. an endless metal belt on which tracked vehicles move over the ground
n. (computer science) one of the circular magnetic paths on a magnetic disk that serve as a guide for writing and reading data
n. a groove on a phonograph recording
translations_zh: n. 轨迹, 足迹, 径迹, 小道, 轨道, 磁轨, 途径
vt. 循路而行, 追踪, 通过, 用纤拉
vi. 追踪, 留下足迹, 沿轨道运行
[计] 跟踪

examples.en: You're on the right track.
examples.zh: 你的想法是對的。

examples.en: the police are following a promising lead

definitions_en: n. a group's refusal to work in protest against low pay or bad work conditions
n. an attack that is intended to seize or inflict damage on or destroy an objective
n. a score in tenpins: knocking down all ten with the first ball

n. (baseball) a pitch that the batter swings at and misses, or that the batter hits into foul territory, or that the batter does not swing at but the umpire judges to be in the area over home plate and between the batter's knees and shoulders
translations_zh: n. 罢工, 打击, 殴打
vt. 打, 撞击, 冲击, 侵袭, 取消, 结算, 打掉, 罢工, 刺透, 使生根, 遇见
vi. 打, 打击, 抓, 罢工, 搏动, 触礁, 敲, 响, 穿透, 打动

examples.en: The general strike paralyzed the whole country.
examples.zh: 全面罷工癱瘓了整個國家。

examples.en: The strike affected the nation's economy.
examples.zh: 罢工妨碍了国家经济。

definitions_en: n. the condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints
translations_zh: n. 自由, 坦率, 特权
[法] 自由, 自主, 免除

examples.en: Freedom of speech is now taken as a matter of course.
examples.zh: 現在言論自由被當作是理所當然的事。

examples.en: Freedom of thought is guaranteed by the constitution.
examples.zh: 思想自由為憲法所保障。

definitions_en: v. to gain with effort
translations_zh: vt. 完成, 达到
vi. 如愿以偿

examples.en: You'll never achieve anything if you don't study harder.
examples.zh: 如果你不更加努力地學習, 你將永遠不會有所成就。

examples.en: That's the true genius of America; that America can change. Our Union can be perfected. What we've already achieved gives us hope for what we can and must achieve tomorrow.
examples.zh: 这才是美国真正的精华——美国能够改变。我们的联邦会日渐完美。我们现在已取得的成就为我们将来能够取得和必须取得的成就增添了希望。

definitions_en: n. a tangible and visible entity; an entity that can cast a shadow
n. (grammar) a constituent that is acted upon
n. the focus of cognitions or feelings
n. (computing) a discrete item that provides a description of virtually anything known to a computer
translations_zh: n. 物体, 目标, 目的, 对象, 宾语, 客体
vi. 反对, 抱反感
vt. 提出...来反对
[计] 对象

examples.en: I don't object to your going out to work, but who will look after the children?
examples.zh: 我并不反对你出去工作，可是小孩靠谁来照看呢？

examples.en: The surface of the object is fairly rough.
examples.zh: 這件物件的表面頗為粗糙。

definitions_en: v. be relevant to
v. think of, regard, or classify under a subsuming principle or with a general group or in relation to another
v. send or direct for treatment, information, or a decision
v. use a name to designate
translations_zh: vt. 提交, 归诸于, 把...提交, 使求助于
vi. 提到, 涉及, 查阅, 查询, 咨询

examples.en: Refer to the dictionary as often as possible.
examples.zh: 儘可能多點查字典。

examples.en: Please refer to page ten.
examples.zh: 請參看第十頁。

definitions_en: n. a person who seeks the advice of a lawyer
translations_zh: n. 客户, 顾客, 委托人
[计] 客户, 客户机, 客户机程序

examples.en: The lawyer warned his client against testifying, but he did it anyway.
examples.zh: 律師警告過他的當事人反對作證, 但是他還是這麼做了。

examples.en: The investor stole the capital of his client.
examples.zh: 投资者把他客户的资金窃取了.

definitions_en: n. an abstract or general idea inferred or derived from specific instances
translations_zh: n. 观念, 概念
[医] 概念

examples.en: To him, hunger was an abstract concept; he always had enough to eat.
examples.zh: 對他來說，「肚子餓」是個抽象的概念，因為他從來就沒有餓過。

examples.en: I really like the concept of this website.
examples.zh: 我觉得这个网站的概念非常好。

definitions_en: a. having great power or force or potency or effect
translations_zh: a. 有力的, 有权力的, 强大的
[机] 强力的

examples.en: America has the world’s largest economy, and its army is the most powerful.
examples.zh: 美国是世界最大的经济体并拥有最强的军队。

examples.en: Love is more powerful than death.
examples.zh: 爱情比死亡更强大。

definitions_en: r. (used to introduce a logical conclusion) from that fact or reason or as a result
translations_zh: adv. 因此, 所以

examples.en: They have a growing population; therefore they need more and more food.
examples.zh: 那國家的人口正在增長，所以他們需要的食物量也愈來愈大。

examples.en: A man can live and be healthy without killing animals for food; therefore, if he eats meat, he participates in taking animal life merely for the sake of his appetite. And to act so is immoral.
examples.zh: 一個人就算不吃肉，也可以健健康康的生活。所以人殺生、吃肉，只不過是為了滿足自己的口腹之慾而已。這種行為是不道德的。

definitions_en: v. direct the course of; manage or control
v. lead, as in the performance of a composition; Barenboim conducted the Chicago symphony for years"
v. lead musicians in the performance of
translations_zh: n. 行为, 举动, 指导
vt. 为人, 指挥, 管理, 实施
vi. 领导, 传导, 指挥

examples.en: Your conduct is perfectly legal.
examples.zh: 你的行为完全合法。

examples.en: Your conduct is absolutely shameful.
examples.zh: 你的行為是絕對可恥的。

definitions_en: v. make known; make an announcement
v. announce publicly or officially
v. give the names of
v. foreshadow or presage
translations_zh: vt. 宣布, 声称, 显示, 预告
vi. 当报幕员, 宣布参加竞选

examples.en: We, ACME Ltd., hereby announce that we will resist with all our strength this hostile takeover.
examples.zh: 我們ACME有限公司，特此宣布，我們將盡我們的力量抵制這種惡意收購。

examples.en: In the first place, I would like to announce several new regulations.
examples.zh: 首先，我想宣布几条新制度。

definitions_en: v. observe, check out, and look over carefully or inspect
v. question closely
translations_zh: v. 检查, 调查, 考试

examples.en: The doctor used X-rays to examine my stomach.
examples.zh: 醫生用X光檢查我的胃。

examples.en: Dentists take X-rays to examine your teeth.
examples.zh: 牙医用X光检查你的牙齿。

definitions_en: n. the event of something coming in contact with the body
n. the faculty by which external objects or forces are perceived through contact with the body (especially the hands)
n. a suggestion of some quality
n. a distinguishing style
translations_zh: n. 触觉, 碰, 触, 机灵, 轻触, 格调, 少许, 缺点, 弹力
vt. 接触, 触摸, 触及, 使接触, 达到, 涉及, 影响到, 使轻度受害, 感动
vi. 触摸, 接近, 涉及, 提到

examples.en: You can get in touch with him at his home tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚你可以在他家联络到他。

examples.en: I'll get in touch with you soon.
examples.zh: 我會很快跟你聯絡。

definitions_en: r. so as to be complete; with everything necessary
translations_zh: adv. 完全地, 十分地, 圆满地

examples.en: Prime numbers are like life; they are completely logical, but impossible to find the rules for, even if you spend all your time thinking about it.
examples.zh: 質數就像人生，它們完全是合邏輯的，但就算你花多少時間來思考，也不能找到它們背後的規律。

examples.en: My life would be completely empty without you.
examples.zh: 如果沒有你，我的人生就會變得空白一片。

definitions_en: n. (biology) a taxonomic category consisting of members of a species that differ from others of the same species in minor but heritable characteristics
n. a difference that is usually pleasant
translations_zh: n. 多样, 种类, 变种, 杂耍
[化] 变种

examples.en: The explanation below was achieved by comparing and contrasting a variety of different theories.
examples.zh: 下面的解釋是通過比較和對比各種不同的理論。

examples.en: There was a great variety of dishes on the menu.
examples.zh: 菜單上有各種各樣的菜色。

definitions_en: n. the work of inquiring into something thoroughly and systematically
translations_zh: n. 调查, 审查
[医] 调查, 调查研究

examples.en: The investigation is under way.
examples.zh: 相關調查正在進行中。

examples.en: It is clearly shown in Johnson's investigation that passive smoking is very harmful.
examples.zh: 在Johnson的调查里，明确地证明了二手烟是很有害的。

definitions_en: a. (weapons) deriving destructive energy from the release of atomic energy
a. of or relating to or constituting the nucleus of an atom
a. of or relating to or constituting the nucleus of a cell
s. constituting or like a nucleus
translations_zh: a. 核子的, 原子能的, 核的, 中心的
[医] 核的

examples.en: A nuclear war will bring about the destruction of mankind.
examples.zh: 核戰爭將會為人類帶來滅亡。

examples.en: All humanity will suffer if a nuclear war breaks out.
examples.zh: 一旦爆發核戰爭，受苦的將會是全人類。

definitions_en: n a scientist who devotes himself to doing research
translations_zh: n. 研究人员

definitions_en: n. the print media responsible for gathering and publishing news in the form of newspapers or magazines
n. a machine used for printing
n. clamp to prevent wooden rackets from warping when not in use
n. any machine that exerts pressure to form or shape or cut materials or extract liquids or compress solids
translations_zh: n. 压, 揿, 按, 人群, 印刷机, 压力, 出版社, 记者, 报刊, 新闻舆论, 紧迫
vt. 压, 压榨, 紧抱, 逼迫, 推进, 强迫征募, 催逼
vi. 压, 重压, 催促, 拥挤, 奋力前进, 受压

examples.en: Press the bell twice.
examples.zh: 按两下铃。

examples.en: The room was jam-packed with reporters waiting for the press conference to begin.
examples.zh: 房间挤满了等待发布会开始的记者。

definitions_en: n. an open clash between two opposing groups (or individuals)
n. opposition between two simultaneous but incompatible feelings
n. a state of opposition between persons or ideas or interests
n. an incompatibility of dates or events
translations_zh: n. 战斗, 冲突, 矛盾, 争执
vi. 争执, 战斗, 冲突, 抵触
[计] 冲突

examples.en: The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.
examples.zh: 在这个城市，白人和黑人间的争端愈演愈烈。

examples.en: He seems not to be aware of the conflict between my father and me.
examples.zh: 他似乎不知道我父亲和我之间的纠葛。

definitions_en: n. the vital principle or animating force within living things
n. the general atmosphere of a place or situation and the effect that it has on people
n. a fundamental emotional and activating principle determining one's character
n. any incorporeal supernatural being that can become visible (or audible) to human beings
translations_zh: n. 精神, 心灵, 灵魂, 态度, 志气, 人格, 情绪, 心情, 烈酒
vt. 诱拐, 鼓励, 鼓舞

examples.en: The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.
examples.zh: 心有餘而力不足。

examples.en: The man on whom you see the Spirit come down and remain is he who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.
examples.zh: 你如果看見聖靈降下，落在誰身上，誰就是用聖靈替人施洗的了。

definitions_en: v. substitute a person or thing for (another that is broken or inefficient or lost or no longer working or yielding what is expected)
v. put something back where it belongs
translations_zh: vt. 代替, 替换, 放回, 归还
[计] 替换; DOS外部命令:取代或更新文件

examples.en: Would you please replace the broken one promptly?
examples.zh: 请快点把碎了的那个换掉好吗？

examples.en: Please replace the empty ink cartridge in the printer.
examples.zh: 请把打印机里面的空的墨粉鼓换掉。

definitions_en: v. inspire with confidence; give hope or courage to
v. spur on
translations_zh: vt. 鼓励, 支持, 激励
[法] 怂恿, 煽动, 助长

examples.en: When I'm sad, my friends encourage me.
examples.zh: 我傷心的時候，我的朋友會鼓勵我。

examples.en: His financial success encouraged him to look for a wife

definitions_en: n. temporary living quarters specially built by the army for soldiers
n. a group of people living together in a camp
n. temporary lodgings in the country for travelers or vacationers
n. a penal institution (often for forced labor)
translations_zh: n. 露营, 帐篷
vi. 露营, 扎营
vt. 使扎营

examples.en: We found it very hard going back to our base camp in the blizzard.
examples.zh: 暴风雪使得我们难以返回营地。

examples.en: A small rock was thrown into our camp.
examples.zh: 小石頭被丟到我們營地。

definitions_en: n. a prominent attribute or aspect of something
n. the characteristic parts of a person's face: eyes and nose and mouth and chin
n. the principal (full-length) film in a program at a movie theater
n. a special or prominent article in a newspaper or magazine
translations_zh: n. 面孔的一部分(如眼、口等), 特征, 容貌, 特色, 特写
vt. 是...的特色, 特写, 放映
vi. 起重要作用
[计] 特性

examples.en: It's not a bug, it's an undocumented feature.
examples.zh: 这不是一个漏洞，而是一个没有写进文档的特性。

examples.en: The audio feature is only available in some sentences in Chinese, Dutch, French, German and Shanghainese.
examples.zh: 音頻功能僅適用在某些語言的句子中，如中文，荷蘭語，法語，德語和上海話。

definitions_en: n. a future prospect or potential
n. capability of existing or happening or being true
n. a possible alternative
translations_zh: n. 可能性, 可能的事
[法] 可能性, 可能发生的事, 不确定权

examples.en: There's a possibility that the man was murdered.
examples.zh: 他有可能是被謀殺的。

examples.en: Is there any possibility of his resigning?
examples.zh: 他有可能辭職嗎？

definitions_en: n. promise of reimbursement in the case of loss; paid to people or companies so concerned about hazards that they have made prepayments to an insurance company
translations_zh: n. 保险, 保险业, 保险费
[医] 保险

examples.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
examples.zh: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。

examples.en: Can I use my medical insurance?
examples.zh: 我可以使用我的醫療保險嗎？

definitions_en: n. a specialized division of a large organization
n. the territorial and administrative division of some countries (such as France)
n. a specialized sphere of knowledge
translations_zh: n. 部门, 系, 机关
[医] 部, 科

examples.en: There is a bookstore in front of the department store.
examples.zh: 百货商店前有个书店。

examples.en: Kelly carries the news department.
examples.zh: 凱利主持新聞部門。

definitions_en: n. a hostile meeting of opposing military forces in the course of a war
v. battle or contend against in or as if in a battle
translations_zh: n. 战役
v. 战斗

examples.en: We won the battle.
examples.zh: 我们战争胜利了。

examples.en: Many soldiers were wounded in the battle.
examples.zh: 很多士兵在戰鬥中受了傷。

definitions_en: n. the event consisting of the start of something
n. the time at which something is supposed to begin
n. the first part or section of something
n. the place where something begins, where it springs into being
translations_zh: n. 开始

examples.en: When you're beginning to look like the photo in your passport, you should go on a holiday.
examples.zh: 当我们开始像自己护照上的照片时，我们该去度假了。

examples.en: Tell us the story from beginning to end.
examples.zh: 請你把故事從頭到尾給我們說一遍。

definitions_en: r. without distinction of one from others
translations_zh: adv. 通常, 逐渐地, 普遍地

examples.en: Korean food is generally very spicy.
examples.zh: 韓國菜一般都很辣。

examples.en: Students generally like a teacher who understands their problems.
examples.zh: 通常学生们喜欢理解他们问题的老师。

definitions_en: n. an unstable situation of extreme danger or difficulty
n. a crucial stage or turning point in the course of something
translations_zh: n. 危机, 危险期, 紧要关头
[医] 危象; 骤退, 临界, 极期

examples.en: In a crisis, you must get in touch with your teacher.
examples.zh: 在危險的時候你必須跟你的老師聯繫。

examples.en: Let us remember that if this financial crisis taught us anything, it's that we cannot have a thriving Wall Street while Main Street suffers.
examples.zh: 让我们记住这一点，如果说这场金融危机教会了我们什么东西的话，那就是我们不可能在金融以外的领域处于困境的同时拥有繁荣兴旺的华尔街。

definitions_en: v. come or bring to a finish or an end; others finished in over 4 hours"
v. bring to a whole, with all the necessary parts or elements
v. complete a pass
v. write all the required information onto a form

r. to a degree possible of achievement or by possible means

examples.zh: 对不起，您拨打的用户暂时无法接通。

examples.en: Burj Khalifa is currently the tallest skyscraper in the world.
examples.zh: 哈里發塔是現時世界上最高的摩天大樓。

examples.zh: 我想和你單獨談談。

examples.zh: 你觉得胸毛是性感的吗？

examples.zh: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。

owed.
